prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website composition comp, 16:10 landscape, first viewport plus a narrow glimpse below
Primary request: Create composition option 2 for the already-approved visual world Variable Engineer for Daniel Vieira Teixeira's freelance software-engineering portfolio. Keep the same identity: an interactive variable-font specimen, near-white stock, ink black, one electric ultramarine accent, radical typography, exact registration marks, and engineering axis readouts. Change only the homepage composition and interaction framing.
Structure: a precise slim top bar with Daniel's name left and Biography / Experience / Contact right. The viewport is split 5/7: on the left, an enormous vertically stacked headline Find the right intervention. fills the height, with the word RIGHT shifting from narrow hairline to heavy expanded type. On the right, a large live problem lens reads four aligned rows—FRONTEND / BACKEND / QA / RELIABILITY—each set in a different width and weight but sharing one baseline system. A horizontal axis track crosses the rows with a blue draggable marker labeled CURRENT FOCUS. Compact body copy below explains Daniel moves across disciplines to solve the actual bottleneck. START A PROJECT is a strong typographic text control at the lower-right, not a rounded button. The bottom edge reveals the beginning of SELECTED INTERVENTIONS as a dense, elegant case index.
Style/medium: unmistakably a functioning 2026 portfolio website, award-caliber art direction, contemporary type foundry specimen fused with engineering controls, asymmetric but rigorous, high contrast, plenty of breathing room.
Color palette: dominant near-white #F4F1EA, ink black #141414, electric ultramarine #315CFF only.
Text (verbatim): Daniel Vieira Teixeira; Find the right intervention.; FRONTEND; BACKEND; QA; RELIABILITY; CURRENT FOCUS; I move across disciplines to solve the actual bottleneck.; START A PROJECT; SELECTED INTERVENTIONS; Cape Town, South Africa.
Interaction implied: dragging the blue focus marker changes width and weight across the four mode rows while keeping content readable.
Constraints: prospective freelance clients must understand the problem-solving offer immediately. No invented client names, outcomes, metrics, awards, testimonials, logos, stock photos, gradients, glassmorphism, neon, terminal aesthetics, rounded SaaS cards, generic service tiles, mock browser chrome, watermarks. Do not turn it into a poster; include real navigation, CTA, and below-fold continuation.
